digest.component_or_area: binding store reconciliation and lifecycle recovery
propositions: Crashes after retired tombstone replacement but before live replacement leave the same identity in both retired and live state, creating a detectable but unsafe partial state.

Recovery must execute at the validated write-bearing boundary in reconcile.py after the under-lock staleness gate but before the first remote issue fetch, and must not run during construction, preview, or dry-run modes.
Completion requires exact agreement between tombstone, forward entry, and reverse entry identities; mismatches or corrupt files must safety-abort without implicit resurrection.
Explicit unretire removes the tombstone and prevents automatic completion; later automatic 200/clear_absent/same-key confirm does not override the durable tombstone intent.
Keyed pending recovery performs no search; keyless pending requires both three misses and 3600 seconds before unbind, with per-entry failures remaining nonfatal to other entries.
Production code must not mutate bindings through all_bindings(); apply_handlers.py must use the narrow facade operation instead.
